name: Liquid Charge
body:
Price 80 gp; Slot —; Weight —; Capacity none; Usage none

DESCRIPTION

This small glass vial is filled with an azure-colored viscous fluid and is slightly cold to the touch. If the fluid comes in contact with organic matter it deals 1d4 points of acid and 1d4 points cold damage (DC 14 Fortitude half ). While the fluid is caustic, its true purpose provides an emergency fuel to power technological items. One vial of liquid charge contains enough energy to fill a 10-charge item or weapon to capacity. A vial of liquid charge can be used only once.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Technological Item; Equipment production lab; Craft DC 25; Cost 40 gp
